meta.name: CCIP wiring of robinhood, step 3 (robinhood) - setChainSelector on the CcipOivDeployer
meta.description: Step 3 (LAST) of the CCIP wiring of robinhood: setChainSelector(4663, 6180753054346818345) on its own CcipOivDeployer 0xD99e4B13fc50A6321f6A84f2D4F83d6e34AE699D, which lets anyone fan out from robinhood. Execute only after every 1-/2- batch has landed: a counterpart not yet wired rejects the stack and its CCIP fee is lost.
